name: sequential-thinking
description: Sequential Thinking MCP server — forces structured cognitive steps before emitting actions. Adapted from modelcontextprotocol/servers.

tools.name: think
tools.description: Record a single step in a structured reasoning process. Each call appends to the sequence; the model must show its work step by step before emitting any code action.

params.nextThoughtNeeded: boolean (required) — whether another step is needed
params.revisesThought: int (optional) — which thoughtNumber is being revised

whenToUse: Before any code edit: think through the change impact
Before any architecture decision: enumerate tradeoffs
Before PR closure: verify all BP/AP checked
mappedToRules: Best Practice #82 (Auditoría de Premisas en Fase 0)
